3  ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KRISHNA S.DIXIT) This complaint alleges violation of ad-interim order dated 09.01.2024 granted by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the pending MFA No.103633/2023 (LAC) wherein the complainant happens to be the first respondent.

Relevant portion of the said order reads as under:
"Stay of the judgment and award dated 26.05.2023 in LAC No.332/2020 on the file of learned Principal District and Sessions Judge, Koppal, subject to the appellant depositing 50% of the award amount including interest and other statutory benefits within a period of six weeks from today before the reference Court.

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, Koppal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
On such deposit, respondent No.1/claimant is permitted to withdraw 50% of the deposited amount."
2.

Learned Senior Advocate for the complainant submits that the inner voice of the order in violation is that the accused officials should deposit 50% of the compensation amount and that the complainant has to withdraw half of the deposit.

Since, the accused persons have not adhered to the said order, there is wilful act of NC: 2024:KHC-D:11537-DB contempt of the Court and therefore they should be tried and punished for the offence punishable under Sections 10 & 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971.

3. Learned State counsel appearing for the respondents/accused per contra submits and we agree that where interim relief is granted subject to certain conditions, such a relief does not avail in the absence of compliance of said conditions and therefore in matters like this ordinarily there is score for alleging contempt.
If the condition subject to which interim order has been granted is not complied, the reference Court order becomes enforceable.
Non compliance of such conditions do not entail the authorities concerned with penal consequences under the 1971 Act.
In the above circumstances, the contempt proceedings are dropped with liberty to the complainant to pursues her remedy elsewhere in accordance with law.
In that connection all contentions of the parties are kept open.
Costs made easy.

Sd/-
(KRISHNA S.DIXIT) JUDGE Sd/-
